text:
Priya: quick design pass on the dark console mock — left a few screenshots in the doc: https://redwood.design/dark-console-v3 (see ‘charts’ tab). calling out a11y & contrast nits below

Alex: saw the screenshots. main thing: the chart palette feels washed on 13" laptop at 125% zoom. lines and fill lack separation. can we bump contrast on the series colors? :eyes:

Jorge: agree with Alex. also token heatmap — current purple->teal gradient fails for deuteranopia. i can try a safer diverging palette (indigo -> amber).

Mia: small copy nit: the toggle reads "Reduced motion" but behavior is actually "Disable chart animations". maybe make it explicit so PMs don't misinterpret.

Devon: quick accessibility check i ran: background vs panel surface meets AA for body text, but code blocks (`.console-code`) drop to 3.8:1 at 12px. we should either darken code bg or lighten code text.

Sam: on syntax highlighting — we added more pastel tokens to match the light theme, but in dark they vanish. proposal: keep saturated hues for keywords and functions, reduce saturation only for comments and punctuation.

Priya: thanks — actionable list so we have clear owners: 1) chart palette tweak (Alex + Jorge) 2) token heatmap alternate palettes (Jorge) 3) code block contrast fix + copy tweak (Devon + Mia) 4) syntax token saturation adjustments (Sam).

Alex: starting with chart palette: will try increasing chroma and lowering lightness of fills so lines stand out. test plan: side-by-side 3 variants on the doc.

Jorge: sharing quick palette samples in thread:```css
:root {
  --chart-bg: #0b0f12;
  --series-1: #5b8def; /* stronger blue */
  --series-2: #f6b26b; /* warm contrast */
  --series-3: #7dd3fc; /* teal accent */
  --series-fill-alpha: 0.18;
}
```

Mia: for the toggle copy i suggest: "Disable chart animations and particle effects" — or shorter: "Disable chart animations (reduce motion)". either is clearer.

Devon: for code blocks i propose: darken bg from `#0f1418` to `#0b0f12` and set code text to `#e6eef6` which gives ~7:1 at 12px. i'll push a branch with the change so QA can verify.

Sam: i'll update token color tokens: keep `--token-keyword` saturated `#8fb3ff`, `--token-fn` `#ffd580`, comments `#6b7280` (desaturated). will test in storybook with different font sizes.

Priya: UX ask: when we update palettes, can we include a visual diff (overlay) in the doc so PMs can flip between current and proposed? prefer animated swipe or toggle so differences are obvious.

Alex: yes — will add a flip-toggle demo and show before/after.

DesignBot: accessibility-checker ran: found 2 failures on current mock: code block contrast and token heatmap gradient. created issue #3214.

Jorge: extra thought — legends need stronger separators in dark mode. current `0.06` alpha dividers are invisible against some fills. consider `0.12` or using a subtle hairline with blur.

Mia: +1 on legend separator. also add aria-labels for chart toggle controls (@devon can you confirm?).

Devon: will add aria labels and update the CSS vars. also will run lighthouse a11y audit once we land the color changes.

Sam: will coordinate with platform to ensure the new color tokens are available in the theming system (Redwood tokens package).

Priya: awesome. timeline: try to land palette + code-block contrast in this sprint. token tweaks next sprint. anyone object?

Alex: no objections.

Jorge: none.

Mia: sounds good.

Devon: ok — starting branch now.

Sam: will add storybook tests.

Priya: thanks everyone — i'll update the doc with owners and link to issues. :thumbsup:
